description.ja: か つ て 、 戦 争 が あ っ た ―
description.en: Once upon a time, there was a war.

description.ja: 旧 地 球 連 邦 軍 主 力 Ｍ Ｓ ド ー ト レ ス 起 動 ！
description.en: The main force of the former Earth Federation army, MS Dortres, is activated!

description.ja: 『機動新世紀ガンダム X』に登場する、旧地球連邦軍などで運用される汎用量産型ＭＳ「ドートレス」がＨＧキットで商品化。
description.en: The general-purpose mass-produced MS "Dortress ", which appears in " Mobile New Century Gundam X" and is used by the former Earth Federation forces, has been commercialized with HGKit.

description.ja: 特徴的な頭部や胴体、脚部、武装等を新規造形パーツで再現し、印象的な機体カラーを成形色で再現。
description.en: The characteristic head, torso, legs, weapons, etc. are reproduced with new molded parts, and the impressive aircraft color is reproduced with molded colors.

description.ja: ●　新規造形パーツを交えドートレスのスタイリングを再現
description.en: ● Reproduce the Dotress styling with new modeling parts

description.ja: 頭部、胴体、脚部に新規パーツを使用し、量産型ＭＳ「ドートレス」の機体フォルムを設定イメージにこだわり立体化。
description.en: Using new parts for the head, torso, and legs, the body form of the mass-produced MS "Dortress" has been made into a three-dimensional model that adheres to the set image.

description.ja: ライトグリーン、オレンジを主体とする機体カラーリングを成形色で再現。
description.en: The aircraft coloring, which is mainly light green and orange, is reproduced with molded colors.

description.ja: ●　武装類を新規造形で再現！
description.en: ● Weapons are reproduced with new modeling!

description.ja: ９０ｍｍマシンガン、シールドを新規造形で再現。
description.en: 90mm machine gun, Seal is reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ●　組み立てやすさ＆ポージングの自由度を関節構造により両立！
description.en: ● Ease of assembly and freedom of posing are achieved by the joint structure!

description.ja: 部隊編成など量産型MSの魅力あふれる集団バトルイメージを演出可能。
description.en: It is possible to create a group battle image full of the charm of mass-produced MS, such as troop formations.

description.ja: 付属武装：　９０ｍｍマシンガン　／　シールド
description.en: Attached weapons: 90mm machine gun / Seal
